transport: 3-wire momentary START + STOP contacts · open-circuit voltage: ? · current: ? · 8-pin remote connector: A STOP, B B-, C START, E REMOTE RUN, F STATUS LAMP (Fig. 29 p.40); as drawn, the switch common is the B- line, so START/STOP are pulled to battery negative; 18 AWG to 30 ft (p.38)
gotchas: "Push and hold the switch at START until the genset starts" (0983-0101 §3.3); STOP is a press.
Holding STOP "for 30 seconds" runs the fuel pump to prime (§3.2) — a relay stuck on STOP primes continuously.
No cool-down: stop is immediate. Faults are shown by lamp blink codes and need a manual restart. Voltage/current on the pins: not stated.
